nom: NEOGEN Real Niacinamide Glow Up Daily Mask

concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the mask calms redness and smooths skin texture.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer describes the product as very hydrating, leaving skin radiant and glowing.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports two clogged pores purged after use and plans to use it weekly.

aspects.libelle: Pad format instead of sheet mask
Stays in place, does not slide
Convenient for targeted areas of face

extraits.texte: I saw this was on sale and decided to try it - so glad I did! This calms my redness caused by rosacea, smoothed the surface of my skin, reduced the appearance of pores and made my skin feel incredibly soft! I will definitely continue to have this in my daily routine!
It isnt a mask. Just super large pads. I look forward to using this product daily. It definitely makes a difference and the price is worth trying.

after cleansing and using this,tmi but 2 clogged pores purged and I will probably use this once a week. it's a little damp wipe you pick up with tweezers. I set it on different parts of my face for a few seconds and wipe it gently around.
Picked these up on a whim & now I'll never go without!! So hydrating and leaves my skin radiant and glowing
This is very convenient to use and doesn't slide down your face so you can actually. move around. Not like the one whole sheet mask, I like how you can conveniently use on parts of the face.
So convenient and effective! I like these smaller masks better because they don't slide down like the big ones.This one seems work really well. Will purchase again!

reserve: The reviews rarely state the reviewer's skin type, so segmentation by skin type could not be produced from this set.
